supporting_observations.claim: During the alerted window, WS-LMARTINS-01 made repeated connections to the explicit proxy at approximately five-minute intervals: examples occur at 13:36, 13:41, 13:46, 13:51, 13:55, 14:00, and 14:06 UTC.

Several of those connections transferred roughly 9.7 KB from the workstation and 43.5 KB in response, a recurring pattern that is compatible with a periodic update check but does not identify the application or destination.
The available connection records show traffic to the internal proxy on port 8080, rather than the ultimate HTTPS destination.

known_telemetry_limitations: The coverage status reports a collection outage from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC for WS-LMARTINS-01 winsec and sysmon, preventing process and endpoint-event attribution during the alerted interval.
The coverage status reports a collection outage for the proxy sensor during 13:30–14:10 UTC, so proxy records identifying the HTTPS destination, URL, or user are unavailable for this interval.
The supplied Zeek connection records identify connections to the internal proxy but not the ultimate destinations; for example, T035-00117 and T035-00284 show the proxy endpoint on port 8080.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic connections were generated by the approved PixelForge updater, another legitimate application, or an unapproved or malicious process.
Which external hostnames or URLs were contacted, and what content was exchanged during the alerted interval.
Whether the transferred data was benign update-check traffic, command-and-control traffic, or data exfiltration.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, URLs where available, and associated client/user details.
Obtain endpoint process/network telemetry for WS-LMARTINS-01 covering the same interval, especially process attribution for the proxy connections.
Check PixelForge updater execution and update-check logs, including whether updates.pixelforge-suite.com was contacted at the observed times.
